name: Coveo
description: Provides integration with the Coveo hosted search platform: config-entity organizations/search-components, a Search API backend for pushing content, secured search via security providers, and a Coveo Atomic search UI block.

suggests.drupal/search_api: Used for directly pushing logic and server side search interfaces.

project_description:
NOTE: This module is under active development and should not yet be considered production-ready. 

 Versions 1 
 Version 1 provides a Search API integrations that provide the ability to push and search content using Coveo's APIs.

 Current features 
 
 Field Syncing with Coveo 
 Autocomplete 
 Facets 
 Sorts 
 Filters 
 Coveo JS Framework Embed 
 
 Versions 2 
 Version 2 is a large scale refactor that will provide deeper integration with Coveo focusing on exposing exposing all the features of their various JS search frameworks.

 Current features 
 
 Search API integrations for pushing content 
 Search API integrations for pushing identities 
 Coveo Atomic development tools and block 
 Security provider integrations to provide secured search 
 Ability to link multiple environments/organizations. Allows linking a production environment read only so you can preview changes on production environments 
 
 

 Back to top
